productBrief: cortex: A synthetic focus-group platform where AI personas with persistent memory debate products. Researchers define a target market; system mints archetype iNFTs encrypted on 0G Storage, spawns them as AXL peer-to-peer nodes, runs moderated multi-turn session, synthesizes findings. Personas accumulate skills across sessions. Key tensions: synthetic vs real insight, cost per session ($0.50), slower 0G Compute vs GPT-4, personas can only speak not act, session quality depends on archetype diversity.
contradictions: $0.50 per session is too low vs. perceived value of abstract insights
usefulness of personas accumulating skills vs. inability to act
painPoints: limited capability of personas to act on feedback
opportunities: enhance persona capabilities to include acting on feedback
increase session cost to reflect the value of abstract insights
provide more actionable insights in the debates
rawSummary: Panelists expressed concerns about the abstract nature and cost of the synthetic insights, questioning their relevance and trustworthiness. They suggested improving the personas' capabilities to include acting on feedback and increasing the session cost to better reflect the value proposition.
